digest.component_or_area: inbound reconciler — parent field detection and mutation emission
propositions: A parent removed in Jira is never signaled to rebar because the snapshot omits the parent field when it is falsy, making a de-parenting indistinguishable from an issue that never had one.
The inbound differ refuses to emit parent_id=None because it cannot distinguish 'Jira has no parent' from 'parent key is unresolvable yet', creating ambiguity that collapses into no mutation.

An inbound parent clear must fire only on positive peer evidence that the parent once existed; without that evidence the feature deletes local state on truncated reads and failed REST calls (the 63-ticket incident).
The peer evidence channel is the per-binding ADR-0026 baseline for parent, which must be advanced by reconcile every pass that observes the parent field, and must block clears when absent or unset.

The managed_refs gate cannot decide whether to clear because it answers 'was this ref created locally' not 'did the peer ever have it', and the distinction is load-bearing for correctness on both Jira Cloud and Data Center.
